title: Data model and migration

any: database schema or persisted representation changes
backfill or compatibility migration is needed

skill_calls.when: schema, lifecycle, or compatibility boundaries change

nodes.obligation: Implement forward, compatibility, backfill, and rollback behavior as applicable.

tests.evidence: old and new data states have an explicit supported path

tests.when: rollback or resumable recovery is supported
tests.evidence: failure leaves data in a defined recoverable state

workline_policy: Separate when migration order, deployment, environment, or recovery evidence differs from application implementation.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when no persisted schema, representation, lifecycle, backfill, or compatibility behavior changes.
repair: Migration failure reopens only the migration and consumers bound to the invalid stored shape.
